Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: rdma-fabric-high-jitter (sev2) — pagerduty oncall Maya, priority: page
Alex: seeing sustained packet retransmits on 3 racks, started ~10:12 UTC. GPU serving nodes dropping connections and a few containers restarted.
Maya: i'm on it, grabbing logs from the fabric. @Eng-Infrastructure can you confirm?
Eng-Infrastructure: confirmed, IB counters show rising retransmit and out-of-order acks on subnet A. mturcv errors ~10:11.
Priya (runtime): GPUs reported KV cache invalidations and then CUDA driver errors, several containers crashed with: 
```
E cuda: cuCtxSynchronize() failed: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
E runtime: kv_cache_corrupted, clearing prefix cache for model: redwood-v1-small
```
Jordan (sre): what's customer impact? any 5xx spike visible?
Alex: yes, 5xx on generation endpoints up ~12% for hostnames serving critical customers. One paying customer, Acme Corp, has a spike in failed completions.
Customer Success Bot: alert sent to Acme with status update. They requested ETA and mitigation plan.
Maya: i'm doing line-rate tests with ibutils, seeing intermittent packet loss 0.5-2% and latency spikes ~300-800us. Could be a port/firmware flaking.
Samir (eng-infrastructure): checking switch logs and link flaps. One QP reset observed between leaf-7 and spine-2 at 10:13. Firmware on spine-2 was updated earlier this week.
Priya: runtime side we saw automatic fallback to non-RDMA for about 2% of requests but KV cache misses increased causing higher latency and memory pressure -> some containers tried to grow memory and hit OOM killer.
Jordan: actionable mitigation suggestions?
Maya: short term: 1) cordon/drain affected nodes in rack-3 to stop noisy retransmits. 2) fail traffic to redundant capacity in region (non-RDMA nodes). 3) increase connection timeouts in proxy to avoid thrashing.
Eng-Infrastructure: prepared an ACL to move traffic off spine-2 for critical pods, can apply in 2 min. Need oncall approval.
Alex: go ahead, apply ACL and start controlled drain of rack-3 nodes. Marking canary first (2 nodes).
Maya: initiating drain on node-gpu-23 and node-gpu-24 now.
Priya: enabling softer memory cgroup cap to avoid OOM killing containers (set memory.soft_limit_in_bytes). Also toggling runtime to prefer non-shared KV caching for a minute.
Jordan: notify customers we have mitigation live and will monitor. Maya, keep me updated every 5 min.
Incident Bot: CHANGELOG - applied ACL redirect away from spine-2 at 10:18 UTC.
Maya: retransmits dropped to ~0.1% after ACL, latency stabilized. No further CUDA ILLEGAL_ADDRESS after drains.
Alex: containers that crashed are restarting normally, memory pressure trending down. Recovery metrics: 5xx back to +2% above baseline.
Customer Success Bot: updated Acme: "We routed traffic off the affected fabric and are seeing recovery; please expect transient retries."
